from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import json,hashlib,re
root=Path.cwd()
parent=root/'reports/research/510300_bank_excess_reserve_buffer_source_qualification_v1'
out=root/'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_source_qualification_v1'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True,parents=True)
def rj(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def ident(p):
 b=p.read_bytes();return {'path':p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
def save(n,o):
 p=out/n
 if p.exists():raise RuntimeError('不覆盖既有实验：'+n)
 p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
now=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
base=rj(parent/'next_experiment.json')
review=[]
patterns=r'贷款总体需求指数|总体贷款需求指数|银行家问卷|银行家调查|贷款需求指数|loan[_ -]?demand'
for rel in base['prior_use_first']+['docs/PROJECT_STATE.md','docs/RESEARCH_DECISIONS.md']:
 p=root/rel;b=p.read_bytes();text=b.decode('utf-8-sig')
 hits=[{'position':m.start(),'context':text[max(0,m.start()-120):m.end()+240]} for m in re.finditer(patterns,text,re.I)]
 review.append({**ident(p),'full_text_read':True,'all_object_keyword_contexts':hits})
protocol={
 'study_id':base['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E77','registered_at':now,
 'status':'REGISTERED_BANKERS_OVERALL_LOAN_DEMAND_DIFFERENT_SOURCE_OBJECT_NO_FINANCIAL_CANDIDATE',
 'question':base['question'],'target_field':base['target_field'],'target_quarters':base['target_quarters'],
 'questionnaire_scope':'银行家问卷主观需求扩散/加权指数，需原方法/银行受访母体和总体题目。不是实际贷款增量、外生需求冲击、供给纯变化或指数资金流。',
 'minimum_source_contract':['真实该季银行家问卷调查报告，当前总体贷款需求题目与原百分比值','原方法与受访母体保留，增加/不变/下降及加权如何定义实际核原附注，缺失UNKNOWN','原目标数值与真实发布页时钟能够同原正文或未见矛盾的原链接版本定位；已知晚版不能冒充早日值','全部29季度及1711原成员/1212评分日保持，缺报告/字段/钟/版本全UNKNOWN，不换分项/最近季或删样本'],
 'clock_contract':'只实际公布日时钟，统计季度/报告署日/页面显示/链接当前文件及当前取得分开。只有历史公布日期时按23:59:59保守处理；首次历史版本认证仍单列。',
 'source_first_plan':'先原2018Q3/2025Q3边界对象及实际目录链接检查同类载体能否满足原字段/方法/钟，然后仅在有可继续证据时取完整29；不按股市收益选择顺序/季度。全母集未取得的原件都UNKNOWN。',
 'route':'官方实际原链接，先本地命名调查来源查找未发现；最多4官方限定查询、1实际目录GET、29发布正文GET和29原附件GET、每个URL一次/最大2并发。禁止猜URL或跨源填数。E76及E17关闭端点不重开。',
 'budgets':{'official_queries':4,'catalog_GETs':1,'current_quarter_release_GETs':29,'current_quarter_original_attachment_GETs':29,'attempts_each_URL':1,'maximum_workers':2,'maximum_single_bytes':20971520,'maximum_total_bytes':134217728,'timeout_seconds':[10,25],'new_equity_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'authenticated_requests':0},
 'budget_difference_from_proposal':'首次实际来源登记明确页面与必要附件分别有一次预算，最多59GET；提案29个原对象未包含成对页面/附件需求。尚无本方向实际查询/GET和金融结果，此处不是失败后扩预算。',
 'old_use_review_scope':review,'same_object_same_scoring_use_found_in_these_finite_actual_files':bool(any(x['all_object_keyword_contexts'] for x in review)),
 'full_repo_no_prior_use_claim':False,'if_same_frozen_use_found':'停止同用途，不改名、加交互或窗口重试。',
 'current_statistic_not_daily_state':'保留经济季度/信息龄，仅陈旧的已公布调查信息；缺季度不拖前值，不能说当前每天真实需求相同。',
 'model_registration':'NOT_REGISTERED_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_FIRST','new_equity_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,
 'old_rejections_preserved':True,'historical_only':True,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,
 'only_executable_assets':['510300.SH','CASH_CNY'],'goal_achieved':False,
 'parents':[ident(parent/'result.json'),ident(parent/'next_experiment.json')]
}
save('protocol.json',protocol)
save('实际旧用途资格.json',{'study_id':protocol['study_id'],'completed_at':now,'finite_original_files_fully_read':15,'records':review,
 'same_object_same_conditional_scoring_use_found_in_reviewed_files':protocol['same_object_same_scoring_use_found_in_these_finite_actual_files'],
 'qualification':'十五实际原件关键词与定义上下文未显示该不同问卷主观需求字段的同一联合评分用途；只作有限判断。','new_labels':0,'new_fits':0})
print('E77实际来源登记完成；十五旧原件完整核对；本方向网络和金融实际运行仍0。')
print('同对象关键词命中',sum(len(x['all_object_keyword_contexts']) for x in review))
